## Blue Hole

A fist thrown so hard it leaves a hole in the sky. Garp's own students say they never saw it coming.

Unlock Blue Hole, visit a town in the New World and reach 30,000 Doriki.

- Unlock Blue Hole
- Land on a town in the New World
- Reach 30,000 Doriki

- Doriki +540, Belly +60,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +12 Training Points (your style)

## The Ryusoken

Sabo's Dragon Claw Fist: fingers held like a dragon's claw, gripping hard enough to crush stone.

Take up the Ryusoken: find a master of the school (a mentor; sneak and talk to them) and be taken in. Only Brawlers and Black Legs can take it up. The school teaches its techniques for nothing as your Doriki grows; the ability tree shows them, but only the school opens them.

**Prerequisites (any of)** — [Fight as a Brawler](st_brawler.md#q-6af8b1fa5699edcb), [Fight as a Black Leg](st_black_leg.md#q-755cf46711746ec7)

**Tasks**

- Be taken into the Ryusoken

**Rewards**

- Doriki +150, Belly +5,000

<a id="q-40cb8d5b0f3ed671"></a>
